en: Dependent on a root and a state associated with a root, there arises a non-root state not associated with a root by way of the root condition ... three. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are three;

under the object condition, one; under the predominance condition, three ... pe ... under the mutuality condition, five; under the resultant condition, three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition, five. (Similar to the "with-root" [section].
Dependent on a root and a state dissociated from a root, there arises a non-root state dissociated from a root by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor dissociated from root, there arises a state that is neither-root nor dissociated from root by way of root-condition ... three. (Abbreviated. Under root: four;
under object: four ... pe ... under prenascence and repetition: one ... pe ... under result: three ... pe ... under non-disappearance: four.
